frequency_question: How often do high-priority executive nominees secure legislative confirmation within a 49-day window when the executive's party holds confirmation power?
membership_rule: Includes principal cabinet and major regulatory agency head nominations under majority party control; excludes withdrawn nominees where intent was abandoned.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named cases representative of high-priority executive agency nominations in friendly Senates.
known_gaps: Excludes minor delays or internal wrangling that do not prevent eventual confirmation within the window.
skeleton: 6 historical high-priority principal health/regulatory nominations evaluated under majority Senate control
validity_reason: Valid through the current legislative and executive term structure.
